tools.name: taggun_list_campaigns
tools.description: List the ids of the receipt-validation campaigns stored on your Taggun account (an empty list is normal). Does not use a scan. Needs the Campaign Validation feature; without it Taggun answers that the feature must be enabled. GET /api/validation/v1/campaign/settings/list.

tools.name: taggun_get_campaign
tools.description: The stored validation rules of one campaign (dates, merchants, products, fraud checks, SmartValidate prompts). Does not use a scan. GET /api/validation/v1/campaign/settings/{campaignId}.

tools.name: taggun_export_reference_data
tools.description: Read the reference data stored on your Taggun account as CSV: product_categories (the category taxonomy), known_merchants (merchant names and locations used for matching) or product_codes (expected product codes). Read-only; does not use a scan. The text is cut at 40,000 characters. GET /api/account

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url · Private data: taggun_scan_receipt_url, taggun_scan_receipt_base64, taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url · Public sink: taggun_scan_receipt_url, taggun_scan_receipt_base64, taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url · Private data: taggun_scan_receipt_url, taggun_scan_receipt_base64, taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url · Public sink: taggun_scan_receipt_url, taggun_scan_receipt_base64, taggun_validate_receipt_campaign_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
